title: Sara Duterte impeachment trial Day 44: What to expect

blocks.text: The second week of the presentation of evidence of the defense team of Vice President Sara Duterte is expected to feature four witnesses who will testify on the status of Cale88 Foods Corporation, a declared asset of the Vice President’s husband, Atty. Manases Carpio.
First on the defense list is Atty. Rainer Dela Fuente of AML Consulting PH who will testify on matters in relation to the Anti-Money Laundering Act and other other related documents.

Second is Dr. Ceferino Rodolfo, a Department of Trade and Industry Undersecretary for Industry Development and Investment Promotions Group, who will testify on matters relating to Cale88 Foods Corporation's registration with the Board of Investments and other relevant documents namely: registration documents submitted by Cale88 Foods Corporation to the Board of Investments; and certificate of Registration of Cale88 Foods Corporations issued by the Board of Investments, including related letters and documents.

Director Pilar Marilyn Pagayunan of the Food and Drug Administration’s Center for Food Regulation and Research, on the other hand, will testify on matters relating to Cale88 Foods Corporation’s product registration for its sweetened banana chips and other relevant documents such as: product registration documents submitted by Cale88 Foods Corporation to the Food and Drug Administration; and certificate of Product Registration under the name of Cale88 Foods Corporation.

The last scheduled witness to testify for the defense is Department Manager III Rowena Mendoza and/or any representative from the Center for International Expositions and Missions (CITEM) of the Golden Shell Pavilion.

Mendoza and/or any representative will testify on matters relating to Cale88 Foods Corporation communications, such as, but not limited to, electronic mail correspondences sent by CITEM to Cale88 and other invitations to the corporation for food expositions.

Anti-Money Laundering Council (AMLC) Executive Director and prosecution witness Ronel Buenaventura earlier told the Senate impeachment court that Cale88 Foods Corporation received P319 million from China and Hong Kong.

Buenaventura made the disclosure when asked by private prosecutor Mae Divinagracia about the total amount of the remittances from China to Cale88, based on the covered transaction reports (CTR) and suspicious transaction reports (STR). — BAP, GMA News
